paragraphs.text: Pita is an Oriq cultist on Arcavios .

Pita wears a mask that emits purple smoke, similar to Extus Narr . This adds a mysterious and sinister aspect to his character. Pita is eager and anxious, emphasizing the lack of time and the need to act quickly. This impatience contrasts with Extus's more measured approach. Pita believes strongly in the Oriq's mission to dismantle Strixhaven , viewing its destruction as a means to democratize magic. His vision is of a world where magic is accessible to everyone, not just a select few. Pita speaks directly and candidly about his views, cutting into conversations to assert his opinions. He shows little regard for the subtlety or delicacy that Extus tries to maintain.

Pita was present when Zimone Wola woke up and was involved in the conversation with Extus and Zimone, displaying urgency about their lack of time. He interrupted Extus's attempt to calmly explain their intentions, emphasizing the ideological justification for their actions and the urgency of their mission.

When Zimone used the braid of ribbons to send Pita and Extus crashing into the wall, Pita raised his hands, signaling they were not there to fight. He attempted to persuade Zimone of the righteousness of their cause. Pita was present when Dean Kianne arrived and a brief battle ensued. He didn't take direct action but was part of the tense standoff, which resulted in the Oriq fleeing the scene.
